ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
029
STUDY 052
Black Lace Sleeves & Pale Blue Sky
Rights check
Source: 24391.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with blonde hair framing her
face peeks out through black lace sleeves that rise
above her head. She wears a black floral lace top with
a soft tied neckline. Her expression is calm and direct,
with soft peach lips. A pale blue sky and blurred foliage
in the background. Soft natural light. Palette of black,
peach, and sky blue. Romantic and dramatic, in the
style of a summer lace editorial.
Romantic, dramatic, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The lace sleeves framing the face are the central
composition.
- Add 'shallow depth of field' to blur the background.
